# Gryd

> At Gryd, we make solar simple. Gryd offers developers and homeowners a smarter way to power new-build homes by providing fully-funded solar and storage that exceeds regulations and expectations.

Fully funded solar and batteries. Meeting compliance. Reducing build cost. Unlocking developments.

Homes that are cheaper to build and more affordable to run.

## Tools

Three tools. Each answers a question before you commit a plot. One sizes the solar and battery on a scheme and puts a number against it. One checks a house type specification against the incoming Future Homes Standard. One maps what UK council housing has installed so far.

- [Tools](https://gryd.energy/hub-directions/g/tools.html): the three tools, and what each one answers.
- [Site assessment](https://gryd.energy/hub-directions/g/site-assessment.html): roof by roof solar and battery sizing across the house types on a site, with the build cost saving and the generation set against the plot count.
- [Future Homes Standard readiness check](https://gryd.energy/hub-directions/g/fhs.html): three questions on house type, specification and contact details return a readiness summary, the gaps against the standard, and a solar and battery specification that closes them.
- [Council Solar Index](https://gryd.energy/hub-directions/g/council-solar-index.html): interactive UK map of council-owned housing rooftop solar uptake and EPC ratings, built from figures reported by UK councils on their solar installations.
